blocks.text: Notwithstanding any other provision of this chapter, any owner, operator, manager or other person who controls any establishment described in this chapter may declare the entire establishment as a nonsmoking establishment. (Ord. 19315 § 6, 9-29-09. Code 1995 § 78-230.)
